title: The Case of the Apsara Theatre
subtitle: Mystery Unfolds Behind the Curtains of Calcutta
summary: When a mysterious visitor interrupts a cozy evening, Feluda and his companions are drawn into the enigmatic world of the Apsara Theatre. Secrets, intrigue, and danger await as the famous detective unravels a puzzle hidden in the city’s shadows. Dive in and discover why Feluda is a legend among sleuths.
